description: A personal knowledge base in plain Markdown that a person and a coding agent both read and write: the EtherPK Format, the Headless Client (an MCP server) and the etherpk agent skill.
rules: Read the AGENTS.md in a graph folder in full before writing a file in it: EtherPK writes the format's rules there.
Bullets are '- ' with two spaces of indentation for each level. Never run a Markdown formatter over a document.
A page's name is the title in its frontmatter, and a journal entry is journals/YYYY-MM-DD.md.
A synced graph has no folder: read and write it through the etherpk MCP tools.
